1. Customer data training/service improvement: must be prohibited (currently permitted)
2. Data deletion timeline: 30 days (currently 90 days)
3. VertexMind exclusivity: must be removed (currently one year)
4. Customer termination notice: 30 days (currently 90 days)

I will not approve the agreement as currently drafted — all four terms must be revised before signature. Let me formalize this decision.
